Active Postcards

Optional photograph

Link an existing Brevo campaign

Use this when you created or planned this email in Brevo. The controller only reads the existing campaign. It never sends, changes or reschedules it. Save your Postcard first.

For a future schedule, enter the exact time you approved in Brevo. Leave empty for an already sent campaign.

Delete this Postcard draft

Deletion cancels an unprocessed request only. Already scheduled or sent campaigns stay in Brevo. Saved recovery versions remain private.

Audience: existing Brevo segment “Postcards — active subscribers”. Unsubscribed and blocklisted contacts stay excluded. No contacts are imported.

The normal cadence is one Wednesday Postcard. Check existing Brevo schedules before adding an extra email. Free-plan quotas and Brevo branding still apply.

Choose at least one hour ahead, or at least five minutes ahead for a linked website publication. Independent emails are scheduled in Brevo. A Postcard linked to a future story waits until that story is actually published, then sends no earlier than your chosen time. This does not require Codex or your computer to stay open; processing can be delayed.
